subject: fix(bench-economy): add ORCH_GATE_OFF to OFF arm env
description: scripts/bench-economy.js line 398: `const offEnv = { ...cleanEnv(process.env), TMPDIR: offTmp };` must become `const offEnv = { ...cleanEnv(process.env), TMPDIR: offTmp, ORCH_GATE_OFF: '1' };`. cleanEnv strips all ORCH_* vars so the OFF arm subprocess hits the orch-gate and can't write solution.js via the Write tool. Gate correctly blocks it (no claim, no workers in flight). Adding ORCH_GATE_OFF gives write access without adding any KB/graph context.

summary: Added ORCH_GATE_OFF=1 to offEnv in bench-economy.js so the OFF arm Claude subprocess can write solution.js without being blocked by the orch gate. Fix merged to main at commit aa4ddd6. OFF arm now works correctly for write-tests and fix-bug scenarios (confirmed trial 7).
